fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: Names the single OpenDDE job generated from these parameters.

fields.name: sequence_molecules
fields.label: Molecules
fields.help: Add one box per unique OpenDDE entity. Set count and an optional matching list of comma-separated IDs, plus the sequence/ligand/ion, type-specific modifications, and optional MSA or template paths.

fields.name: covalent_bonds
fields.label: Covalent bonds (JSON, optional)
fields.help: Native OpenDDE covalent_bonds array. Entity references are 1-based sequence indexes; copy references are 1-based within count.

fields.name: input_json
fields.label: OpenDDE inference jobs (JSON)
fields.help: Complete native OpenDDE input: a non-empty top-level list of named jobs using proteinChain, dnaSequence, rnaSequence, ligand, or ion entities.
fields.help_note: Bio Web writes this text to input.json. Any MSA, template, or ligand-file paths inside it must be absolute paths available to the runner.

fields.name: inputs_file
fields.label: Inference jobs file (JSON)
fields.help: The JSON file defining this run's jobs, in OpenDDE's own input format.
fields.help_note: Choose a file. Its contents are read here and sent as the input document.

fields.name: seeds
fields.label: Override model seeds (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated integers. When set, --seeds overrides every job's modelSeeds; otherwise OpenDDE uses modelSeeds from the JSON or samples a random seed.

fields.name: samples
fields.label: Samples
fields.help: Number of structure samples per seed. The OpenDDE CLI default is 5.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Diffusion steps
fields.help: Number of diffusion steps. The OpenDDE CLI default is 200.

fields.name: cycles
fields.label: Pairformer cycles
fields.help: Number of Pairformer recycling cycles. The OpenDDE CLI default is 10.

fields.name: dtype
fields.label: Inference precision
fields.help: OpenDDE defaults to FP32; BF16 can reduce memory use on supported devices.

fields.name: device
fields.label: Device
fields.help: Auto selects CUDA when available and otherwise CPU.

fields.name: use_msa
fields.label: Use or generate protein MSAs
fields.help: Enable protein MSA features. This may run OpenDDE's external feature-search pipeline unless precomputed paths are supplied.

fields.name: use_template
fields.label: Use protein templates
fields.help: Use template features referenced by templatesPath in the input JSON.

fields.name: use_rna_msa
fields.label: Use RNA MSAs
fields.help: Use RNA MSA features referenced by rnaSequence.unpairedMsaPath. OpenDDE requires protein MSA processing to be enabled too.

fields.name: use_guidance
fields.label: Use training-free guidance
fields.help: Apply OpenDDE's geometry-based Training-Free Guidance to protein-ligand sampling.

fields.name: need_atom_confidence
fields.label: Write atom-level confidence data
fields.help: Write OpenDDE's full per-atom confidence JSON in addition to summary confidence.

fields.name: deterministic
fields.label: Deterministic PyTorch algorithms
fields.help: Ask OpenDDE to use deterministic PyTorch algorithms for reproducible inference.
